LESSON: CONSTRUCTING INNOVATIVE ANIMAL WATERER

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer
2. Practise Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer in the examples.
2. Explain Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer
2. Practise Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
